scope: Two standard T4 tank-set replacements for the retired Citadel and Bloodsteel draft footprints; no live registration, minting, crafting, drops, market listing or combat activation.

catalogueStructure.rule: Replace the two retired draft identities one-for-one; never append these as additional sets.

sets.name: Glassbound Bastionmail
sets.identity: Standard T4 defensive mail-and-plate set focused on dependable mitigation and one controlled emergency shield.

setBonuses.name: Braced Formation
setBonuses.effect: After blocking or mitigating an eligible direct hit, gain 4% Defense for 5 seconds.

setBonuses.name: Hold the Line
setBonuses.effect: When crossing below 35% HP, gain a shield equal to 5% maximum HP for 6 seconds.
setBonuses.activationRule: Threshold crossing only; remaining below it cannot retrigger.

sets.name: Glassbound Ashguard
sets.identity: Standard T4 leather-and-iron tank set with restrained offensive counterpressure.

setBonuses.name: Guarded Return
setBonuses.effect: After eligible direct HP damage, the next basic attack within 5 seconds deals 10% increased damage.

releaseGates: Owner approves both replacement visual families and standard-T4 power read.
Reconcile exact wear levels, base stat profiles and recipes with the authoritative T4 catalogue without changing total set or member counts.
Register set, member and art identities in trusted server catalogues only after Equipment 2.0 approval.
Validate set trigger ordering, cooldowns, threshold crossings, exclusions and reconnect/offline combat determinism.
Keep both sets hidden until the coordinated Equipment, Skills and Combat 2.0 release gate.
